question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

The German advance that ended in this dibacle has been the costliest defeat in point of materials that they have yet suffered.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dibacle"** is incorrectly spelt.

 
 
• English Meaning: The correct spelling is "debacle," which means a sudden and ignominious failure; a fiasco. (अचानक और शर्मनाक विफलता; एक आपदा)
 
• Hindi Meaning: (आपदा)
 
• **Example:** The company's new product launch turned out to be a complete debacle.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"debacle"**.
 
 
• Hindi Meaning: (आपदा)
 
• **Example:** The German advance that ended in this debacle has been the costliest defeat in point of materials that they have yet suffered.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Materials** (सामग्री): The substance or substances out of which a thing is or can be made.

 
 
• **Example:** The construction materials were delivered to the site on time.
 
 
 
• **Advance** (आगे बढ़ना): Move forward, typically in a purposeful way.
 
 
• **Example:** The troops were ordered to advance towards the enemy lines.
 
 
 
• **Costliest** (महंगा): Involving a lot of loss or sacrifice; very expensive.
 
 
• **Example:** The project turned out to be the costliest endeavor the company had ever undertaken.
 
 

34:Tac1,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
